verdict.rationale: Updates are explicit rather than silent: `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` must be run to pull the latest compatible stable release (gh-6). Customized or unrecorded copies are flagged for review rather than overwritten or deleted (docs-3), and skills are independently versioned releases (docs-19, docs-20). However, the evidence never shows pinning to a specific version or a committed team lockfile. missing for 10: documented version pinning, a shareable lockfile/manifest for team-wide reproducibility, independent or hands-on corroboration of the update-control behavior.
